changes: The 51 PMT questions that repeated a past-paper question (47) or an earlier PMT question (4) are removed; the original is kept with its own wording, marks, mark scheme and difficulty, and gains any chapter or skill the copy had.
Papers now holds 83 PMT questions (58 Core Pure 1, 25 Core Pure 2; 704 marks) and 9,149 questions in all.
The PMT tickbox is removed. PMT questions are exam-style questions: they appear under "Exam style" for pupils and in teacher exam papers, where only the mark scheme names the source.
A saved selection that held a removed copy now holds the question kept in its place, once, and says so.
The bank never holds two copies of a question: every importer refuses a copy, the release gate fails on one, and the whole bank was checked once (no further copies).
56 PMT questions now name their original exam in the mark scheme, each confirmed by sight against the paper; the other 27 are recorded as unknown.
reportIntro: Luisa v0.77 keeps one copy of every question. The 51 PMT questions that repeated a past-paper question or an earlier PMT question are gone; the original stays, with its own wording, marks and mark scheme. Papers now holds 83 PMT questions and 9,149 questions in all.

The PMT tickbox has gone: PMT questions are exam-style questions, in pupil practice and in teacher exam papers, where only the mark scheme names the source. A permanent rule stops any future import from adding a copy, and a check of the whole bank found no other copies.
changelog: Papers: 51 duplicate PMT questions removed from `pmt-catalogue.json`, `content/pmt/` and `resources/pmt/` (survivor: the official paper, else the earliest PMT question); chapter keys and skills carried to the survivor; `migrations` in `pmt-catalogue.json` maps each removed ID to its survivor for saved selections. Traceability in `docs/evidence/v077-duplicates-removed.json`.

No-duplicates rule: `scripts/duplicates.py` (candidates, check, incoming, remove) with decisions in `docs/evidence/duplicate-decisions.json`; `scripts/luisa.py check` fails on any copy, undecided candidate or stale migration; `scripts/import/pmt.py` and `scripts/import/integrate.py` refuse copies; the generator's copy safety net stays.
Papers: the PMT tickbox, its state key and its tests are removed; PMT rows are in the exam-style bank; a saved `pmt` key is ignored.
Mark scheme: a PMT question with a visually confirmed original exam (`originalExam`, 56 of 83) names it after its source; evidence in `docs/evidence/v077-pmt-original-exams.json`.
Tests: `tests/test_duplicates.py` (bank, importers, gate), PMT counts 83/58/25, the no-tickbox and migration browser test, live check that PMT questions are exam-style in every edition.
roadmap: [Issue #141](https://github.com/vyr66mbzmh-debug/Luisa/issues/141) removes the 51 duplicate PMT questions, adds a permanent no-duplicates rule with an importer and gate check, retires the PMT tickbox so PMT questions are exam-style, and records confirmed original exams (PAP-077-1 to PAP-077-5).
